Scottish wildcat demographic models

Jun - Sept 2026 · with Mark Beaumont, Dennis Prangle and Grace Yan

Summer internship fitting 2D dadi models to the joint site frequency spectrum of wildcat and domestic cat, with Godambe-corrected confidence intervals. The preferred model puts their split at roughly 485,000 years ago.

Repo, Report, Blog

Introgression and selection in Scottish wildcats

Sept - Dec 2025 · with Mark Beaumont

A genome scan for domestic cat introgression and selection in wildcats, pointing to candidate genes in GABA transport, taurine transport and calcium signalling.
